project.title: Infrastructure Decommission & Migration
project.role: DevOps, Operations and Cloud Architect; Project Management

parentsummary.deliverables: Managed the full divestiture of the HighRoads V1 software product's infrastructure portfolio — spanning development, QA, staging, demo, training, DR, and production environments — orchestrating C-level stakeholder coordination, a transitional access control program, legal and financial escrow reporting, and safe decommission of legacy data centre assets as part of an asset sale.
parentsummary.outcomes: Delivered a HIPAA-compliant active-passive DR architecture meeting NIST RTO/RPO objectives, with zero production downtime throughout the migration and decommission lifecycle, satisfying asset sale contractual obligations and escrow compliance requirements.

challenge.summary: An asset sale required a project to divest software, development environments, QA environments, staging environments, demo environments, training environments, DR environments, and production environments for the V1 software product.

deliverables: Stakeholder reporting and meetings with C-Level executives and Board Members
Needs analysis, define requirements, and plan migration route
Architectural design and PoC implementation with modernization of infrastructure
Security Coordination and alignment to required Guidelines (HIPAA & NIST)
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Map to ISO:27001, NIST, and HIPAA
Perform safe deconstruction and decommission of legacy data centre and hosted solutions
Developed the transitional access control program governing system hand-over
Orchestrated joint requirements sessions between selling and purchasing organizations
Staged migratory testing of services with inline remediation
Pre-migratory pen-testing and security reporting, load testing, and failure/high-availability testing
Decommission of legacy hardware, separation of hardware
Project Close-Out, Stakeholder reporting, Legal/Financial reporting for Escrow fund compliance
Documentation preparation for Operations staff, Development staff, Management, and external acquiring company

outcomes: ✅ Managed the full divestiture of the HighRoads V1 product infrastructure portfolio — spanning development, QA, staging, demo, training, DR, and production environments — delivering compliant handover documentation, legal and financial escrow reporting, and safe decommission of legacy data centre assets in support of a successful asset sale
